## Change Summary
The diff updates `deep_merge` to initialize the result as a deep copy of `a`, completely preventing mutation of the input dictionaries. It replaces the naive assignment loop with a conditional that detects shared nested dictionaries and merges them recursively, while safely copying all other values from `b`. This directly resolves both the clobbering and mutation defects described in the task.

## Defects
None found. The implementation correctly isolates inputs via deep copying, handles recursive merging without side effects, and aligns with the passing acceptance test.

## Assessment
Structural checks confirm a clean modification with no syntax or import issues. The acceptance test exits successfully, verifying that the logic meets all stated requirements and maintains compatibility with existing tests. I did not find any defects; the change cleanly addresses the core problems without introducing edge-case failures or unnecessary overhead.
